events.title: School Star Party at Valley Christian School
events.description: School star party at Valley Christian School for elementary aged children. Set up at 5. Start time at 5:45 or 6 pm. Moon comes up just after dark. Good blacktop with a few lights scattered about.
events.location: Valley Christian School, 7500 Inspiration Drive, Dublin, CA 94568

events.title: School Star Party at Kolb Elementary School, Dublin
events.description: School Star party at Kolb Elementary in Dublin. Set up about 5 pm to start viewing 5:45 or so. Saturn should be up when it is dark, we might get a hint of Jupiter if we stay late enough. The event planners would like a headcount for us, so if you plan on volunteering, please add your name to this google doc. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GAN9HT7xtf6GcrE_o3d5uP9-8Kr-za4PX65MBjXRYJk/edit?usp=sharing
events.location: Kolb Elementary School, 3150 Palermo Way, Dublin
